llm_response.reason: The website pretends to be an official Mizuno retailer under a highly suspicious, personalized .shop domain. It heavily uses scam website characteristics: offering unsubstantiated discounts, free shipping, psychological comfort phrases ('100% Secure Shopping'), broad and generic product range, and lacks any valid company or professional contact information. Search results tie similar sites to scam warnings. There is no evidence of business legitimacy, and all features align with tactics used by fake online shopping platforms.
